answer: Re-attestations are stored in copper and anchor lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 17 epochs, which means holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the zephyr graph. A farm of 1831 identities would post 4404 proofs and burn roughly 38 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
